question: cot²A - cos²A is equal to
solution:
**Given:**

cot2A - cos2A

**Concept used:**

cosec²θ - cot²θ = 1

**Calculation:**

cot2A - cos2A

⇒ (cos²A)/(sin²A) - cos²A 

⇒ cos²A((1)/(sin²A) - 1)

⇒ cos²A(cosec²A - 1) 

⇒ cos2A.cot²A 

**∴ The required answer is cos​2A. cot​2A.**
